recent_events: A canoe of Breath-Holder divers glides past, heading for the outer reef. Elder Ama sits at the stern, eyes closed, breathing slowly. The morning dive is sacred. You pass in silence.
Your crew relaxes. Something about the Gold Coast waters changes the mood. Shoulders drop. Voices soften.
